name: Ethan Chen
title: Engineering Manager
summary: An accomplished Engineering Manager with over 8 years of experience leading cross-functional teams in the development and delivery of scalable software solutions. Proven ability to drive technical strategy, foster a collaborative team culture, and consistently exceed project goals in fast-paced environments. Expert in agile methodologies, cloud infrastructure, and optimizing development lifecycles.

bullets: Managed a team of 8 software engineers, increasing team productivity by 25% through improved agile practices and process optimizations.
Led the successful migration of a monolithic application to a microservices architecture on AWS, reducing operational costs by 15% and improving system reliability by 20%.
Oversaw the full lifecycle of 3 major product releases, consistently delivering projects 10% ahead of schedule and within budget.
Mentored junior engineers, leading to a 40% reduction in critical bugs and a 15% improvement in code quality across the team.
Designed and implemented core components for a high-volume data processing platform, handling over 1 million transactions daily.
Improved system performance by 30% through targeted code optimizations and database query enhancements.
Collaborated with product management to define technical requirements and feasibility for new features, contributing to a 10% increase in user engagement.
Developed and maintained RESTful APIs for client-facing applications, serving over 50,000 active users.
Participated in daily stand-ups and sprint reviews, contributing to a 95% on-time delivery rate for assigned tasks.
Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests, reducing production incidents by 20%.

education.degree: Master of Engineering in Software Engineering
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
